statement: NVIDIA reports extreme memory pricing conditions that exceeded its expectations and are expected to rise further next year.
why: Memory is the biggest bought-in cost in an accelerator, so this squeezes margins and signals a tight HBM market.

impact.mechanism: Sharply higher memory prices indicate memory supply is short relative to accelerator build plans, raising system cost.

evidence.source: MarketBeat (Q2 FY2027 earnings call transcript excerpt)
evidence.excerpt: We are experiencing extreme pricing conditions in memory. The magnitude of the price increase has exceeded our prior expectations and are headed even higher into next year.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript aggregator; single source, no corroborating memory-vendor filing fetched.
